worked_solution:
We need to use integration by parts. We'll work out the indefinite integral first, and then proceed to work out the definite integral.

In this case, we define

$$
\begin{aligned}u=({log}_{4}⁡x)^{2}\, & ⟹\,\frac{\text{d}u}{\text{d}x}=\frac{2{log}_{4}⁡x}{x\operatorname{ln}⁡4} \\ \frac{\text{d}v}{\text{d}x}=81{x}^{2}\, & ⟹\,v=\int \frac{\text{d}v}{\text{d}x}\,\text{d}x=\int 81{x}^{2}\,\text{d}x=27{x}^{3}.\end{aligned}
$$

Using the formula of integration by parts, we get

$$
\begin{aligned}\int 81{x}^{2}({log}_{4}⁡x)^{2}\,\text{d}x & =\int u\frac{\text{d}v}{\text{d}x}\,\text{d}x \\  & =uv-\int v\frac{\text{d}u}{\text{d}x}\,\text{d}x \\  & ={({log}_{4}⁡x)}^{2}(27{x}^{3})-\int (27{x}^{3})(\frac{2{log}_{4}⁡x}{x\operatorname{ln}⁡4})\,\text{d}x \\  & =27{x}^{3}{({log}_{4}⁡x)}^{2}-\frac{54}{\operatorname{ln}⁡4}\int {x}^{2}{log}_{4}⁡x\,\text{d}x.\end{aligned}
$$

We use integration by parts once again to evaluate  $\int {x}^{2}{log}_{4}⁡x\,\text{d}x.$ We take

$$
\begin{aligned}u={log}_{4}⁡x\, & ⟹\,\frac{\text{d}u}{\text{d}x}=\frac{1}{x\operatorname{ln}⁡4} \\ \frac{\text{d}v}{\text{d}x}={x}^{2}\, & ⟹\,v=\int \frac{\text{d}v}{\text{d}x}\,\text{d}x=\int {x}^{2}\,\text{d}x=\frac{{x}^{3}}{3}.\end{aligned}
$$

In this case, the formula for integration by parts gives

$$
\begin{aligned}\int {x}^{2}{log}_{4}⁡x\,\text{d}x & =\int u\frac{\text{d}v}{\text{d}x}\,\text{d}x \\  & =uv-\int v\frac{\text{d}u}{\text{d}x}\,\text{d}x \\  & =({log}_{4}⁡x)(\frac{{x}^{3}}{3})-\int (\frac{{x}^{3}}{3})(\frac{1}{x\operatorname{ln}⁡4})\,\text{d}x \\  & =\frac{{x}^{3}{log}_{4}⁡x}{3}-\frac{1}{3\operatorname{ln}⁡4}\int {x}^{2}\,\text{d}x \\  & =\frac{{x}^{3}{log}_{4}⁡x}{3}-\frac{{x}^{3}}{9\operatorname{ln}⁡4}+D,\end{aligned}
$$

where $D$ is an integral constant.

So we have

$$
\begin{aligned}\int 81{x}^{2}({log}_{4}⁡x)^{2}\,\text{d}x & =27{x}^{3}{({log}_{4}⁡x)}^{2}-\frac{54}{\operatorname{ln}⁡4}(\frac{{x}^{3}{log}_{4}⁡x}{3}-\frac{{x}^{3}}{9\operatorname{ln}⁡4}+D) \\  & =27{x}^{3}{({log}_{4}⁡x)}^{2}-\frac{18{x}^{3}{log}_{4}⁡x}{\operatorname{ln}⁡4}+\frac{6{x}^{3}}{{ln}^{2}⁡4}+C \\  & =\frac{27{x}^{3}{ln}^{2}⁡x}{{ln}^{2}⁡4}-\frac{18{x}^{3}\operatorname{ln}⁡x}{{ln}^{2}⁡4}+\frac{6{x}^{3}}{{ln}^{2}⁡4}+C \\  & =\frac{{x}^{3}}{{ln}^{2}⁡4}(27{ln}^{2}⁡x-18\operatorname{ln}⁡x+6)+C,\end{aligned}
$$

where $C=-\frac{54D}{\operatorname{ln}⁡4}.$

Note that in the above calculation, we used the change of base formula ${log}_{4}⁡x=\frac{\operatorname{ln}⁡x}{\operatorname{ln}⁡4}.$

Finally, we can work out the definite integral:

$$
\begin{aligned}{\int }_{1}^{e}81{x}^{2}({log}_{4}⁡x)^{2}\,\text{d}x & ={[\frac{{x}^{3}}{{ln}^{2}⁡4}(27{ln}^{2}⁡x-18\operatorname{ln}⁡x+6)]}_{1}^{e} \\  & =\frac{{e}^{3}}{{ln}^{2}⁡4}(27{ln}^{2}⁡e-18\operatorname{ln}⁡e+6)-\frac{{1}^{3}}{{ln}^{2}⁡4}(27{ln}^{2}⁡1-18\operatorname{ln}⁡1+6) \\  & =\frac{{e}^{3}}{{ln}^{2}⁡4}(27-18+6)-\frac{1}{{ln}^{2}⁡4}(0-0+6) \\  & =\frac{15{e}^{3}}{{ln}^{2}⁡4}-\frac{6}{{ln}^{2}⁡4} \\  & =\frac{1}{{ln}^{2}⁡4}(\,15{e}^{3}-6\,)\end{aligned}
$$
html:
We need to use integration by parts. We'll work out the indefinite integral first, and then proceed to work out the definite integral.

In this case, we define u=(log4⁡x)2⟹dudx=2log4⁡xxln⁡4dvdx=81x2⟹v=∫dvdxdx=∫81x2dx=27x3.

Using the formula of integration by parts, we get ∫81x2(log4⁡x)2dx=∫udvdxdx=uv−∫vdudxdx=(log4⁡x)2(27x3)−∫(27x3)(2log4⁡xxln⁡4)dx=27x3(log4⁡x)2−54ln⁡4∫x2log4⁡xdx.

We use integration by parts once again to evaluate ∫x2log4⁡xdx. We take u=log4⁡x⟹dudx=1xln⁡4dvdx=x2⟹v=∫dvdxdx=∫x2dx=x33.

In this case, the formula for integration by parts gives ∫x2log4⁡xdx=∫udvdxdx=uv−∫vdudxdx=(log4⁡x)(x33)−∫(x33)(1xln⁡4)dx=x3log4⁡x3−13ln⁡4∫x2dx=x3log4⁡x3−x39ln⁡4+D, where D is an integral constant.

So we have ∫81x2(log4⁡x)2dx=27x3(log4⁡x)2−54ln⁡4(x3log4⁡x3−x39ln⁡4+D)=27x3(log4⁡x)2−18x3log4⁡xln⁡4+6x3ln2⁡4+C=27x3ln2⁡xln2⁡4−18x3ln⁡xln2⁡4+6x3ln2⁡4+C=x3ln2⁡4(27ln2⁡x−18ln⁡x+6)+C, where C=−54Dln⁡4.

Note that in the above calculation, we used the change of base formula log4⁡x=ln⁡xln⁡4.

Finally, we can work out the definite integral: ∫1e81x2(log4⁡x)2dx=[x3ln2⁡4(27ln2⁡x−18ln⁡x+6)]1e=e3ln2⁡4(27ln2⁡e−18ln⁡e+6)−13ln2⁡4(27ln2⁡1−18ln⁡1+6)=e3ln2⁡4(27−18+6)−1ln2⁡4(0−0+6)=15e3ln2⁡4−6ln2⁡4=1ln2⁡4(15e3−6)
